[Topics]{.eyebrow}

Our work spans soil microbial ecology, antimicrobial resistance, and pathogen
genomics, unified by a One Health framing and a methodological commitment to
long-read sequencing. Each topic below collects the motivation, the resulting
publications, and the students who did the work.
